title: Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease Remarketing Fee on TRAC Deficiencies for Kestrel Retail and Balloon Customers
content:
# Relationship Pricing Bulletin — Remarketing Fee within a TRAC Deficiency

**Rule.** For the deficiency billed on a TRAC unit of the Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease whose sale settlement falls short of its book value, the deficiency remarketing fee is $150 where the business holds both an active Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract and an active Kestrel Advantage Balloon contract, $250 where it holds exactly one of the two, and the remarketing fee of the unit's program tier where it holds neither.

**Which contracts.** A Kestrel Advantage Balloon contract is a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract. What is read is whether the business holds one of each kind whose status is active.

| Active Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract | Active Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract | Deficiency remarketing fee |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | $150 |
| Yes | No | $250 |
| No | Yes | $250 |
| No | No | the tier's remarketing fee |

## Cases (hypothetical)

1. A business with an active balloon contract and a retail installment contract closed last year: exactly one active, $250.
2. A business with two active retail installment contracts and an active balloon contract: both kinds, $150.
3. A business holding neither kind in a tier whose remarketing fee is 395: 395.
